title: Future paths: where the roadmap goes next

sections.name: claim
sections.label: Claim
sections.content: A roadmap the owner can hold is built per domain, outward: understand one domain (its personas, problems, remedies, tensions and the conversations that made it), set its priorities there, then move sideways to a sibling or up to the parent. The objective/epic roadmap stays, but is fed from domains rather than replacing them.

sections.name: story
sections.label: The story so far
sections.content: Opened 2026-11-04 from two owner vignettes in conversation 09be2f75: the registry drifting toward a network (662defe9) and each domain having its own future, with affirmation performed in context (c020fd77). The research notes below log what was found and what is settled; the boards hold the suggested problems and remedies derived from them.
